title: Understanding Violin Plots
text: A violin plot is useful for visualizing the distribution of a dataset. It shows the density of the data at different values. Think about whether this type of plot can help you understand how many games were played by different players.

title: Choosing the Right Plot
text: Which type of plot is best for visualizing the distribution of a numerical variable like $$games_{played}$$?

title: Interpreting the Data
text: Look at the $$'games_{played'}$$ column. Notice how the values are distributed. A violin plot can show you the spread and density of these values. Consider if this visualization helps in understanding the data better.
